- Comprehensive rehabilitation consultation

Patient demonstrates excellent cognitive function and strong family support. Recommended continued multidisciplinary approach to management.

- Proper machine sterilization techniques
- Monitoring of dialysis access site
- Recognizing early signs of infection or complications

- Nephrology follow-up scheduled for October 3, 2023
- Home health nurse visit planned for September 22, 2023, to assess dialysis access and provide additional support
- Recommended continued use of home dialysis system with close monitoring

Discharge Recommendations:
- Continue current medication regimen
- Maintain strict fluid and dietary restrictions
- Monitor weight daily
- Report any signs of infection, excessive bleeding, or access site complications immediately
